title: AICon Routine
description: A saved AICon routine: a reusable capability that appears as a real button in Revit. Two kinds share this one file format so a 'composed' routine written today keeps loading unchanged after the scripting layer lands.

schemaVersion.description: Format version. AICon refuses to load a routine whose schemaVersion it does not understand rather than guessing.

id.description: Stable identity, lowercase kebab-case. This is what makes saving idempotent: saving twice with the same id updates in place instead of creating an orphan folder. Also the folder name.

name.description: Human-facing name, shown in the routine browser.

description.description: What it does and when to use it. Shown as the button tooltip and given to the AI when it lists routines.

kind.description: 'composed' = an ordered list of existing aicon: tool calls (no compilation, always available). 'script' = C# in sibling .cs files, compiled at load time (needs code execution enabled).

ribbon.description: Where the button appears. Omit entirely for a routine that should only be reachable from the routine browser or from the AI.

panel.description: Ribbon panel name inside the AICon tab.

buttonText.description: Button caption. Use \n to wrap onto two lines. Defaults to 'name'.

icon.description: PNG filename relative to the routine folder (32px). Falls back to AICon's generic routine icon.

inputs.description: What the user (or the AI) must supply. AICon generates BOTH the WPF form and the MCP input schema from this single list — never write a form by hand.

label.description: Field caption in the form. Defaults to 'name'.

description.description: Hint under the field; also the property description in the MCP schema.

type.description: 'enum' renders a combo box (see 'options'). 'elementId' renders a text box plus a Pick-in-model button. 'stringArray' renders one-per-line text.

default.description: Pre-filled value. Any JSON type matching 'type'.

readOnly.description: True when the routine only reads the model. Surfaced to MCP clients as readOnlyHint so an agent can treat it as safe.

destructive.description: True when the routine deletes or overwrites. Surfaced as destructiveHint; AICon also asks the user to confirm before running it from a button.

steps.description: REQUIRED when kind is 'composed'. Executed in order inside ONE Revit transaction group — the whole routine commits or rolls back together, so a single Ctrl+Z undoes it.

args.description: Arguments for the tool. Any string value may contain placeholders: {{input.<name>}} for a routine input, {{steps.<saveResultAs>.<field>}} for a value returned by an earlier step.

saveResultAs.description: Names this step's result so later steps can read it, e.g. saveResultAs 'sheet' then {{steps.sheet.id}}.

continueOnError.description: When true a failing step is recorded and the routine carries on. Default is all-or-nothing.

comment.description: Why this step exists. Ignored at run time.

script.description: REQUIRED when kind is 'script'. C# source ALWAYS lives in sibling .cs files — never inline in this JSON.

files.description: Source filenames relative to the routine folder, compiled together into one assembly.

entry.description: Optional class name to run when several are present. Defaults to the single class found.
